definitions.duration: data.time at last logged step - data.time right after the single reset
definitions.avg_forward_speed: sum of per-step pelvis displacement projected on the instantaneous reference heading / duration
definitions.max_lateral_offset: max |cumulative integral of the cross-track component of per-step pelvis displacement| relative to the instantaneous reference heading
definitions.max_lateral_from_reference: max perpendicular distance between policy pelvis and reference pelvis, projected on the lateral axis of the initial reference heading
definitions.tilt: pelvis: angle between root body +z and world +z; trunk: angle between (upper_body_mimic - pelvis_mimic) and world +z
definitions.foot_slip: tangential speed of the contacting foot material point (v_body + omega x r), integrated while normal force > 20 N
definitions.max_lateral_deviation: max(max_lateral_offset, max_lateral_from_reference); this is the quantity compared against the 0.35 m threshold
